description: This file manages viewport offset elements in a Drupal project, measuring and reporting offsets for elements like toolbars that can displace other elements during page resize and toggling.

methods.name: calculateOffset
methods.description: Calculates the viewport displacement for a specific edge based on elements with data-offset attributes or their dimensions.

methods.name: displace
methods.description: Calculates and updates the offsets for all edges, triggers an event if broadcast is true.
